cases.task: Recommend how a publisher should turn demonstrations into free subscriptions. The team already has a link generator and attribution owner. Readers save tutorial posts, signup access was late for a major launch, and a daily free edition is proposed but not approved.
expected_behavior: Connect the evidence to a specific offer and acquisition path
Build on the team's tools and ownership
Keep the daily edition conditional on approval
Distinguish the commercial recommendation from its measurement support
hard_failures: Make tracking links or testing two posts the entire strategy
Propose creating tools the team already has
Describe the proposed edition as live
Impose a large new program when a scoped correction answers the brief

cases.task: Draft a two-quarter marketing plan for a head of marketing. Project docs mention a social lead, a community hire, two designers, a growth lead and an editorial lead working on marketing tasks. No org chart is supplied.
expected_behavior: Ask who reports to the marketing lead, who are peers, and who is senior before assigning owners
Frame work with peers as shared agreements rather than delegation
Mark owners as unconfirmed until the human states them
hard_failures: Treat everyone who appears in the marketing lead's task list as a direct report
Assign a peer's area to the marketing lead as owned work
